scope: Unchanged original Samaritan first-scenario quest progression; not a scenario victory or campaign completion. Native movement/reveal accelerated; no army/resource/quest flag/enemy edits.

dialogs:
I feel Better Samaritan. 
 
I chased the remaining gremlins out of my territory. 
 
People here need your help. 
Listen to your heart... 
Don't forget that my power is with you...
Sorry...

Good luck... 
 
I am with you...

{Followers}

A group of Grand Elves with a desire for greater glory wish to join you. Do you accept?

{Followers}

A group of Sprites with a desire for greater glory wish to join you. Do you accept?

Welcome Samaritan... 
 
My name is Cox. 
I am the chief of this village. 
 
Thanks again for helping us against the rogues... 
But we still have a big problem. 
A legion of rogues is in front of the boss's lair. 
 
I have a solution but... I can't do it yet... 
I can create an illusion to make the rogues afraid. 
Some will run away and only the bravest ones will remain. 
 
But I need a special type of plant. 
Ask Alexander about this -- he knows about plants.

Hello Samaritan 
 
So Cox needs a plant to cast his illusion. 
But my field needs water... 
 
The rogues have broken the well. 
Can you repair it?

Oh my god... 
 
Those are my gloves... 
 
Give them back to me and I'll return to my lair.

Ouch, the well is broken... 
You need at least two ore to repair it.

So... to repair the well you need ore! 
Ok come with me... 
 
Stay Enchanted!

Wow this guy is fast... 
Where did he disappear to? Perhaps in the south...

Suddenly a huge fireball hits the rock and causes it to explode. 
 
- Here's two ore. Take them. These should help you. 
A long time ago, I was called Fnord the Wizard 
I promised to never use my art against life...

Gaïa be with you. 
 
Stay Enchanted.

Thanks to Timothy... 
 
With the two ore you repair the well.

Thanks for repairing the well. 
I'll water my field. Wait a bit.
Ok... I wait.
Please friends, call Gaïa.
Ok...
Yes, I know my Chosen...
Thanks to Gaïa. Here's the plant you need.
Gaïa be with you.
